name: COB — 6X.1 — contract exclusion limit dollar in the COB sub-tab
description: Seven steps mapping onto the 6X.1 source document: resolve the events and establish that RB2 is not setting, check the coded COB row against the other insurer's EOB, read the Group Reason Codes and their responsibility, open the COB table with the pen icon, correct the Copay to 15.00, validate the claim and read back that the 6X event has cleared, and pay the claim.

steps.name: Resolve all events and rule out RB2
steps.description: Open the Event Resolution tab and resolve every event from top to bottom before going further, referring to the Hierarchy of Events — CI&W workflow for assistance. When the 6X event is set on the claim it is the one to resolve first: 6X fires on a mismatch in the contract-exclusion / limit-dollar values in the COB sub-tab, which happens when the system reads a primary insurer's paper claim incorrectly — capturing the wrong amount, or adding a minus sign. Then read the list again for one thing in particular: is the RB2 event setting on this claim? If RB2 is present, follow the alternate guidelines instead. In this scenario every event has been resolved and RB2 is not among them, so you proceed.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: All Edits lists seven codes with PX_6X active. Read every one and check for PX_RB2 — it is not there, so the alternate guidelines do not apply.
steps.checklistItem: Resolve all events and rule out RB2

steps.name: Verify the COB sub-tab against the EOB
steps.description: Open Claim Data → COB and determine whether the sub-tab is coded correctly against the claim form (EOB). This includes any dollar amount carrying a Group Reason Code, which has to sit in the field that matches the responsibility. The sub-tab shows the other insurer's EOB: Name DIS 'Other Insu', Policy 12345, EOB date 9/9/2026, with Allowed 200.00, Deductible 0, Copay 10.00, Coinsurance 0, Non-elig 0, Discount 100.00, Excl 0, Contr 0, Sub liab 0, Withhold 0 and Paid 185.00. Scroll down to the reason codes and compare. If it is coded correctly, continue under the standard guidelines; if it is not, correct it. Here it is not: PR-3 COPAY reads 15 while the Copay field reads 10.00 — and the EOB's own Paid of 185.00 against an Allowed of 200.00 only balances at a Copay of 15.00.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the COB sub-tab is opened while this step is active. COB is not the Claim Data default sub-tab, so the visit is a real click.
steps.hint: Claim Data → COB. Read the amounts row, then scroll to the reason codes beneath it and compare the Copay against PR-3.
steps.checklistItem: Verify the COB sub-tab against the EOB

steps.name: Determine the Group Reason Code responsibility
steps.description: Open the EOB and EOMB Reason Codes online reference and determine the responsibility of the Group Reason Code. The codes on this EOB are CO-45 PROVIDER DISCOUNT = 100, PR-1 DED = 00, PR-2 COINSURANCE = 0 and PR-3 COPAY = 15, where PR-1 is Deductible, PR-2 is Coinsurance and PR-3 is Copay. CO is a contractual obligation and falls on the provider; PR is patient responsibility and falls on the member — which is what decides that the PR-3 amount belongs in the Copay field. Where the responsibility is Member, the Create, Delete or Modify a COB Popup in CI&W reference gives the instructions for updating the sub-tab. This confirms the correct Copay is 15.00.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only on opening the reason-codes reference. Returning to the COB sub-tab completes nothing — step 2 already took that visit.
steps.hint: On the COB sub-tab, open 'EOB and EOMB Reason Codes' and read which group code is the member's responsibility.
steps.checklistItem: Determine the Group Reason Code responsibility

steps.name: Open the COB table for editing
steps.description: On Claim Data → COB, click the pen icon to make the COB table editable. The amounts row becomes a row of input boxes carrying the values currently coded on the claim.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only on the pen. Until it is pressed the amounts row is read-only and no input is on screen.
steps.hint: The pen icon sits at the end of the Commercial block on the COB sub-tab.
steps.checklistItem: Open the COB table for editing

steps.name: Update the Copay value to 15.00
steps.description: In the Copay text input box, change the value from 10.00 to 15.00 so it matches the PR-3 COPAY reason code. The row then reads Allowed 200.00, Deductible 0, Copay 15.00, Coinsurance 0, Non-elig 0, Discount 100.00, Excl 0, Contr 0, Sub liab 0, Withhold 0 and Paid 185.00 — and 200.00 less the 15.00 copay is the 185.00 the other insurer paid, so the row now balances.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when the Copay box holds 15. Entering 15 in any of the other ten boxes completes nothing, and leaving 10.00 in place completes nothing.
steps.hint: Type 15 into the Copay box. 200.00 allowed less a 15.00 copay is the 185.00 paid.

steps.name: Validate the claim
steps.description: The Copay now matches the PR-3 reason code, so run the claim through validation before deciding anything. Click Validate on the claim summary bar. The claim is processed again against the corrected COB sub-tab, and the Validation section on the Event Resolution tab reports what came back — read it and confirm the 6X event has cleared rather than taking your own arithmetic on trust. Validate is held back until the correction is made, so what it reports describes the claim as you have left it rather than as it arrived.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is pressed while this step is active. Validate carries no guard of its own — step 5 is what grades the Copay, and the step order is what holds this press back until that correction is in.
steps.hint: Click 'Validate' on the claim summary bar, then read the System message under 'Event Resolution → Validation'.

steps.name: Submit the Pay decision
steps.description: The COB sub-tab has been updated and all current established unit guidelines have been followed, so the claim can be processed. Go to the Decision section on the claim summary, select Pay from the dropdown and click Submit.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when the claim is submitted with Pay. Deny or Pend does not complete it.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' from the Decision dropdown on the claim summary bar and click Submit.
